07 BEFORE YOU ARRIVEA LITTLE CLARITY

CURIOUS
MINDS
WELCOME.

Do I need experience with meditation?+

Not at all. Sound meditation is an opportunity to listen and relax, whether you're completely new or have an established practice.

What happens during a sound session?+

Sessions may include a gentle introduction, an opportunity to rest comfortably, and a live sound experience with instruments such as singing bowls, gongs and chimes. Your facilitator will share the details for your chosen session.

Can I book a private or couples session?+

Yes. Choose a private or couples experience, and send us your preferred date and time. Our team can confirm availability with you directly.

How do I know what's coming next?+

Upcoming gatherings appear in the session calendar. You can reserve available spots online when a session is open for bookings.

Where is the studio located?+

Anantaal Meditation Studio is opposite Vidya Bhawan Auditorium, Dewali, Fatehpura, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313004.
